deeponet.config_snapshot:
# Frozen discretization settings and parameter box for
# "Galerkin-Certified Neural Operators for Tempered-Fractional CGMY Pricing PIDEs".
#
# This file is the single source of truth for the discrete spaces and the
# parameter ranges used across the whole pipeline (reference solves,
# certification, dataset generation, training, experiments). See CLAUDE.md
# "Frozen numerical setting" / "Hard invariants #6" — nothing hardcodes
# these values elsewhere. Changing any value here invalidates previously
# generated datasets and certificates unless explicitly re-tagged with a
# new discretization/config id.
#
# The parameter_box ranges below were NARROWED after Stage D found that
# S_h(mu) -- the operator the entire certification stack (Stage C) needs
# SPD -- loses positive-definiteness across large parts of the original
# box. A 200-trajectory Stage D dataset run showed 90% of a stress-biased
# split and 17% of an edge-biased split were not SPD; a systematic grid
# sweep (see the Stage D->E handoff) isolated M as the dominant driver
# (near-universal failure at M>=17-20, worse at low G) plus a separate
# C-near-0.01 + Y-near-1.10 interaction. The ranges below were validated
# against 0/500 fresh Sobol points, 0/64 exact box vertices, and 0/100
# points at a second mesh resolution (N=96, vs. the N=64 used for the
# sweep) -- not just re-checked on the same sample that found the problem.
# Y was deliberately left untouched (it is this paper's headline parameter);
# M absorbed most of the narrowing since it was the dominant driver.
# They are still candidate ranges pending Stage A's other validation gates
# (Gates 1-3 in CLAUDE.md) -- this fixes the SPD-loss finding specifically.

discretization:
  spline_degree: 3            # p — TODO(Stage A): confirm via Gate 1-3
  n_elements: 256              # h = (domain_right - domain_left) / n_elements — TODO(Stage A)
  n_time_steps: 200            # dt = maturity / n_time_steps — TODO(Stage A)

  # CORRECTED after Stage A inspection of the trusted solver
  # (cgmy_bspline/cgmy_bspline/solver_cn.py): it runs pure Crank-Nicolson
  # from tau=0. There is no Rannacher/backward-Euler startup in the trusted
  # solver, despite what CLAUDE.md's "Key objects" section assumed. Do not
  # reintroduce a rannacher_startup_steps field unless that scheme is
  # actually implemented and validated in the trusted solver.
  time_stepping: crank_nicolson

  # Omega = (log K - 10, log K + 10), with K fixed at 100 (see contract below).
  # CORRECTED after Stage A inspection: the trusted solver's own default
  # domain (cgmy_bspline.grid.make_grid) is NOT this fixed, symmetric-in-K
  # window -- it is mu-dependent: target_left = domain_scale/G,
  # target_right = domain_scale/M (domain_scale=10 by default), so the
  # domain width and asymmetry change with G and M. These domain_left/right
  # values are only used when a mesh explicitly overrides the domain (e.g.
  # cgmy.reference_solver.Mesh with x_min/x_max set); solve_cgmy's default
  # (x_min=x_max=None) uses the solver's own mu-dependent domain instead.
  # See scripts/stage_a_difficult_corners.py for how domain choice affects
  # truncation error across the parameter box.
  domain_left: -5.394829814011909    # log(100) - 10
  domain_right: 14.605170185988091   # log(100) + 10

parameter_box:
  # CGMY Levy triplet
  C: [0.05, 1.0]    # narrowed from 0.01: C near 0.01 + Y near 1.10 lost SPD
  G: [1.0, 5.0]     # unchanged
  M: [2.0, 9.0]     # narrowed from 20.0: dominant SPD-loss driver, see above
  Y: [1.10, 1.80]   # unchanged (deliberately preserved)

  # Market parameters
  r: [0.01, 0.10]

  # Contract parameters
  maturity: [0.1, 1.0]     # T, years

contract:
  strike: 100.0             # K — fixed, not sampled

payoffs:
  # CORRECTED after Stage A inspection: only the European put has validated
  # boundary conditions in the trusted solver (its Dirichlet values encode
  # the put's own far-field asymptotics). cgmy.reference_solver.solve_cgmy
  # only accepts EuropeanPutPayoff for this reason. Adding "call" requires
  # deriving call-specific boundary conditions first (new numerics).
  families: ["put"]

certification:
  acceptance_tolerance: 1.0e-3
  # PCG preconditioner for the Riesz solve (certification.riesz_solver):
  # 'none' or 'mass' (uses the cached M_h factorization). Stage C found
  # mass-preconditioning increases, not decreases, kappa(M_h^{-1} S_h(mu))
  # relative to unpreconditioned kappa(S_h(mu)) for the baseline test point
  # -- see the Stage C report. Kept as 'mass' (the default in
  # riesz_solver.solve_riesz_pcg) pending confirmation; 'none' may be a
  # better default.
  preconditioner: mass
  max_pcg_iterations: 200

seed: 0
